title: Site transport preserves the canonical Cartesian proper/open interchange
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $p:V\to T$ a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $i:W\hookrightarrow T$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and set $U=V\times_TW$, with projections $k:U\hookrightarrow V$ and $r:U\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the uncompleted unbounded derived operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Assume $p$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and all four schemes are Noetherian, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. On the small etale sites use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact open extensions $i_!^e,k_!^e$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], and write $a_H=\nu_H^*$ for exact comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $b_u:a_{\mathrm{target}(u)}Ru^e_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*a_{\mathrm{source}(u)}$, for $u=p,r$, be the counit-normalized comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. Let $e_i:a_Ti_!^e\xrightarrow{\sim}i_!a_W$ and $e_k:a_Vk_!^e\xrightarrow{\sim}k_!a_U$ be the termwise open comparisons [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Let $\Gamma^e:i_!^eRr^e_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp^e_*k_!^e$ be the specified Cartesian comparison [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange]. For $M_0\in D^+(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ set
$$C_{a_UM_0}=(Rp_*e_k)\circ(b_p k_!^e)\circ(a_T\Gamma^e)\circ(e_i^{-1}Rr^e_*)\circ(i_!b_r^{-1}):i_!Rr_*a_UM_0\longrightarrow Rp_*k_!a_UM_0.$$
This is an isomorphism. For a witness $\alpha:a_UM_0\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], the formula
$$C_M=(Rp_*k_!\alpha)\circ C_{a_UM_0}\circ(i_!Rr_*\alpha^{-1})$$
is independent of witness, natural in $M$, and has the canonical open-adjunction normalization
$$\lambda_M\circ i^*C_M=1_{Rr_*M},\qquad C_M=\varepsilon_i\circ i_!(\lambda_M^{-1}),$$
where $\lambda$ is [lem-exc-proetale-derived-open-restriction] and the adjunction is [prop-exc-open-adjoint]. All inputs $M$ here are bounded below and of etale origin; no unrestricted ambient exceptional adjoint or all-sheaf finite-CD datum is assumed.
